summary: Child groups referenced in a static inventory must be defined there too, so to make a static group of dynamic groups, declare the dynamic groups as empty.
questions: How do I group dynamic inventory groups in a static file?
Why does Ansible error that my child group isn't defined?

answer_card.title: Static parent of dynamic groups
answer_card.answer_md:
Declare the dynamic groups empty in the static file:
```ini
[tag_Name_staging_foo]

[tag_Name_staging_bar]

[staging:children]
tag_Name_staging_foo
tag_Name_staging_bar
```
